category.name: Range
category.preferred_workflow: Create a local Document instance, optionally add sections or form fields, then operate on doc.Range or a node's Range using documented methods such as Replace, FindReplaceOptions, Bookmarks, FormFields, and node insertion via DocumentBuilder or InsertBefore/InsertAfter on parent nodes. Validate only the requested output and persist the result.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference members that are read-only or absent in Aspose.Words 26.10.0.
Never use System.Range in place of Aspose.Words.Range.
canonical_patterns: Use DocumentBuilder for inserting bookmarks, form fields, or new paragraphs.
Use Range.Text for read-only extraction; use Range.Replace with FindReplaceOptions for modifications.
Iterate over range.Bookmarks or range.FormFields to enumerate names and types.
nullable_warning_prevention: Always ensure a node (e.g., first paragraph) exists before accessing its ParentNode or inserting before it.
Create required sections, bodies, and paragraphs locally before processing.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0200 because Section.Body or Range.Text is assigned a value.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Attempting to set properties that are defined as read-only in the Aspose.Words API.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use the appropriate insertion methods (e.g., DocumentBuilder, InsertBefore) instead of assigning to read-only members.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the API reference to verify mutability before writing to a property.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0104 due to a conflict between System.Range and Aspose.Words.Range.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code imports both namespaces without aliasing, causing the compiler to treat Range as ambiguous.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Alias Aspose.Words.Range (e.g., using AsposeRange = Aspose.Words.Range) or fully qualify the type.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Avoid importing System.Range or always qualify the Aspose.Words.Range type.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1061 errors appear for methods such as BookmarkCollection.Add, Range.InsertBefore, Range.Search, or FormField.StartNode.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code calls members that do not exist in the selected Aspose.Words version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the call with the documented alternative (e.g., DocumentBuilder.StartBookmark, parentNode.InsertBefore, doc.Range.Replace).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference the official Aspose.Words documentation for the exact method signatures.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS7036 errors indicate required parameters (e.g., maxLength for InsertTextInput) are omitted.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code supplies an overload that does not match any available signature.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Provide all required arguments as defined in the API, using named parameters when helpful.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Review method overloads in the API reference before coding.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime NullReferenceException occurs because a source file or document node was never created.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The example expects an existing file or document structure that was not bootstrapped locally.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create deterministic sample documents, sections, and files within the code before processing them.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always include local input creation steps as part of the workflow.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime checks examine unrelated document internals, causing failures unrelated to the task.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Validation logic is too generic and touches nodes that are not part of the requested operation.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Validate only the existence of the output file and the specific range result required by the task.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Scope assertions to the exact behavior being demonstrated.

narrative.overview: The Range category focuses on using Aspose.Words.Range and node-scoped Range objects for text extraction, search-replace, bookmark, and form-field operations. Verified examples demonstrate correct document bootstrapping, section-level text retrieval, form-field counting, bookmark enumeration, and safe insertion of text.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding agent with clear guidance to generate reliable Aspose.Words snippets that manipulate document ranges without invoking unsupported members, ambiguous types, or external resources.
validation_priorities: Confirm that the generated code compiles against Aspose.Words 26.10.0 and that the expected output file is created.
maintenance_notes: Periodically verify that all referenced Aspose.Words members remain unchanged in future package releases.
